theorem bbolt.erase_of_first {α : Type} [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] (l : List α) (x : α) (j : Nat)
    (hbefore : ∀ (k : Nat), k < j → l[k]? ≠ some x) (hat : l[j]? = some x) : l.erase x = List.take j
    l ++ List.drop (j + 1) l
